Markets.title: US stocks: US market ends slightly lower as bond yields hold near multi-decade highs
Markets.summary: US stocks closed slightly lower as consumer confidence fell to a 12-year low and government bond yields held near multi-decade highs. Investors reacted to declining job openings, a pessimistic economic outlook, and differing views from Federal Reserve officials on future interest rates.

Markets.title: Fed rate hike 'not urgent', says John Williams; Austan Goolsbee warns against 'playing with fire'
Markets.summary: New York Fed President John Williams stated the central bank could implement one more interest rate increase before the end of the year while awaiting more economic data. He projected that inflation will end the year at approximately 3.5% before reaching the Fed's target by 2028.

Markets.title: Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas divest over 68 lakh BSE shares worth Rs 2,186 crore ahead of Nifty 50 inclusion
Markets.summary: Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas sold 68.33 lakh shares of BSE for Rs 2,186.44 crore through bulk deals on the NSE. Mutual funds purchased 52.43 lakh of these shares ahead of BSE's entry into the Nifty 50 index, pushing the stock up 3.31%.

Markets.title: US 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.6%, reaching highest level since 2002
Markets.summary: US 30-year Treasury yields rose above 5.6%, reaching their highest level since 2002 amid a global bond selloff. This increase was driven by rising energy prices, inflation fears, rate hike expectations, and heavy corporate bond issuance.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Nifty's indicative price sharply plunged 2% during the closing auction session on monthly expiry before recovering. Analysts attribute ongoing market pressures to crude volatility, high US Treasury yields, FII outflows, IPO fundraising, and geopolitical tensions.

Markets.title: CarMax's quarterly profit, revenue rise as pricing boosts used-car sales
Markets.summary: CarMax reported an increase in second-quarter profit and revenue. The growth was driven by a pricing strategy that boosted used-car sales.

Geo-Political.title: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat
Geo-Political.summary: Following protests over the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, Spain announced a ban on evictions. The ban is part of a package of proposals that must receive parliamentary approval within 30 days.

Geo-Political.title: 'I was lured into a trap': Evan Gershkovich on moment that led to 16 months in Russian jail
Geo-Political.summary: Released US journalist Evan Gershkovich recounted being lured into a trap and detained in Russia for 16 months. He stated he realized he was a pawn in a greater game because FSB agents did not interrogate or torture him.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village and block Palestinian family's return home
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli settlers attacked a West Bank village, setting fire to two homes belonging to the al-Tubasi family and blocking their return home. During the incident, the settlers also targeted Israeli security forces.

Geo-Political.title: Dutch police arrest suspected member of group that claimed FBI hack
Geo-Political.summary: Dutch police arrested a 24-year-old suspected member of a hacking group that claimed responsibility for an FBI breach. The arrest occurred before the alleged cyber attack took place.

Geo-Political.title: First female prime minister named in Morocco after winning elections
Geo-Political.summary: Morocco has appointed its first female prime minister following recent elections. Her appointment by the king makes her only the second woman to lead an Arab government.

Geo-Political.title: Eiffel Tower chief to quit after female staff replaced by men during religious visit
Geo-Political.summary: The head of the company operating the Eiffel Tower is resigning following controversy over female staff being replaced by men during a religious visit. The operating company condemned the staffing change as unacceptable.

AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This discovery demonstrated a shift from traditional search engine optimization to AI optimization for generating free organic traffic.

Data & Insights.title: China’s ‘10 million tonnes’ US coal bet is about more than energy: What Beijing gets from trade deal | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: China's potential purchase of 10 million tonnes of US coal provides a new export market for American miners. This trade deal also serves as a strategic concession to help Beijing navigate broader trade negotiations with Washington.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon wants fewer trade barriers with Europe. But there’s a catch
Data & Insights.summary: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon supports reducing trade barriers between the US and Europe. However, he stated that the EU must first reform its economy, defense, and energy sectors.

Data & Insights.title: Shaktikanta Das flags eastward shift in global economy, urges Global South to seize opportunities
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Shaktikanta Das noted that the global economy is shifting eastward toward Asia. He urged nations in the Global South to focus on trade, energy, food security, and job creation to capitalize on this change.

Data & Insights.title: RBI rate hikes: Nomura predicts only 50 bps against market’s 125 bps bet, anticipating moderation in inflation pressures
Data & Insights.summary: Nomura predicts the Reserve Bank of India will raise interest rates by only 50 basis points, which is lower than the market expectation of 125 basis points. This conservative outlook is based on the expectation that inflation pressures will moderate.

Data & Insights.title: RBI drains $20 billion liquidity via FX operations: What it means for rupee, rates
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has drained nearly $20 billion from the banking system through foreign exchange operations, bond sales, and reverse repos. These measures and tax outflows have sharply reduced excess rupee liquidity, with FX swaps emerging as a key management tool.

Data & Insights.title: Trade agreement can contribute to ‘better’ India-US ties, says Jaishankar as Piyush Goyal set to hold talks
Data & Insights.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that a trade agreement between India and the U.S. would improve bilateral relations, though negotiations have faced complex ground realities. His comments came as Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal prepared to hold trade talks with U.S. officials.

India.title: 5 New Sites Added To India's UNESCO Tentative List For World Heritage
India.summary: India has added five new locations to its UNESCO tentative list for World Heritage. One of these is Madhya Pradesh's Udaigiri hill, which features a rock-cut sacred ensemble built under Gupta patronage during the late 4th and early 5th centuries.

India.title: Local Shiv Sena (UBT) Leader Dies In Thane After Firing By Unidentified Men
India.summary: A local Shiv Sena (UBT) leader named Purnekar was shot dead by unidentified men in Thane. At the time of his death, he served as the Thane division head, or "vibhag pramukh," for Uddhav Thackeray's party.

India.title: No Mother-Child Photo On Baby Food Packets, Orders Team Tukaram Mundhe
India.summary: Official Tukaram Mundhe has ordered baby food manufacturers to display the "Mother's Milk Is Best" message on all product packages. The directive also prohibits the use of mother-child photographs on these food packets.

India.title: Delhi Bans Bus Strikes For 6 Months, Commuters Get Relief
India.summary: The Delhi government has banned bus strikes for six months by invoking the Essential Services Maintenance Act. This decision provides relief to daily commuters who rely on bus transportation.

India.title: Noida Gang Rape Survivor Tried To Escape, Bus Conductor Locked Door: Cops
India.summary: On August 4, a minor from Uttar Pradesh boarded a bus in Greater Noida after being falsely told it was heading to Noida Sector 63. The bus conductor locked the door when she tried to escape a gang rape.

India.title: Lashkar Terrorist Gunned Down During Encounter With Security Forces In J&K
India.summary: Security forces shot and killed a Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist during an encounter in Jammu and Kashmir. The joint operation was conducted by the Army, police, and CRPF.

General.title: Burnham vows to end existing pension triple lock in 2030 to help fund care
General.summary: Prime Minister Burnham has pledged to end the state pension triple lock in 2030. He announced this policy during a conference speech to help fund future care costs.

General.title: Chris Mason: Burnham delivers deeply political speech with a personal core
General.summary: BBC political editor Chris Mason describes Andy Burnham's speech as both deeply political and personally emotional. The address combined the tone of a potential future prime minister with the grief of a mourning son.
